claims.evidence: Witness report says make/model not readable in the photos; only 'industrial sewing machine on work table' is confirmed.
No readable brand/origin markings reported by the witness.
Witness observations mention a foot pedal and cables, but no proof of running/testing is included.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual are included
claims.evidence: Witness notes a rack with many thread cones/spools and some accessories, but exact accessory/manual count and whether the original manual is present are not shown.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service records or maintenance evidence is reported.

risks.risk: Exact machine type/function is unclear (single-needle vs overlock/coverstitch/multi-thread), which affects value and suitability.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the machine head model plate/label and the needle/loopers area (or a video showing the stitch type).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic industrial sewing machine setup with unknown function and unknown performance.

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (timing, stitch quality, motor health, needle bar/belt condition).
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running under power and sewing a test seam (showing consistent stitches and no abnormal noise).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as not proven/untested for sewing performance.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness is uncertain (presser feet, bobbins, needles, thread guides, manuals).
risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo/video of every included accessory plus a photo of the manual cover/title page.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete accessory set (manual/extra feet not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Power/voltage compatibility and correct plug are uncertain for Abuja use.
risks.proof: Photo of the machine’s power rating/voltage label and the exact plug/cord end.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring buyer to confirm/replace power components.

risks.risk: Wear/damage/oil leaks/rust/belt or motor mounting issues may exist but aren’t clearly shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the belt/motor area, needle bar, presser foot mechanism, and any underside/leak points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (no warranty on condition).

risks.risk: Cables and floor setup suggest it may have been used heavily and may need cleaning/maintenance.
risks.proof: Video showing cable condition and a brief run test after setup cleaning.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/possibly needing basic servicing.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the machine head model plate/label (brand, model, voltage) and any origin markings.
Video of the machine running and sewing a short test seam (show stitch consistency and no abnormal sounds).
Photo/video inventory of all included accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, thread guides) laid out individually.
Photo of the original manual cover/title page (and any serial/model reference inside).
Close-ups of belt/motor area, needle bar/presser foot mechanism, and any signs of oil leaks/rust.
Photo of the power cord/plug end and the voltage rating label.
response.reason: The witness report confirms an industrial sewing machine on a work table with pedal/cables and a thread/accessory rack, so it can be priced at its worst-case as an unverified, used industrial sewing setup with unknown make/model and unproven working condition.
